label: Pricing
seo_description: Compare Starter, Growth, and Enterprise capabilities across admissions, academics, finance, portals, offline sync, workflows, and governance.
headline: Plans shaped around how schools actually operate.
subheadline: Starter for digitizing core operations, Growth for full admissions-to-reporting cycles, Enterprise for multi-campus governance and advanced depth.

segments.title: Starter
segments.body: Core records, attendance, communications, and straightforward reporting for schools beginning digitization.

segments.title: Growth
segments.body: Admissions pipelines, fees and invoicing, grading and report cards, analytics, and richer portal adoption.

segments.title: Enterprise
segments.body: Multi-campus controls, offline sync, integration-ready APIs, advanced analytics, audits, and priority implementation.

metrics.label: plan archetypes
metrics.detail: Starter, Growth, and Enterprise packaging aligned to operating maturity.

metrics.label: capability depth
metrics.detail: Turn modules on as governance requirements increase—not duplicate tenants.

metrics.label: upgrade story
metrics.detail: Growth path documented against admissions, finance, offline, and analytics depth.

metrics.label: implementation
metrics.detail: Enterprise engagements include rollout planning conversations.

faqs.question: Which plan fits a single-campus school?
faqs.answer: Starter focuses on digitizing records, attendance, communications, and baseline portals; Growth unlocks admissions depth and billing sophistication.

faqs.question: When should schools choose Enterprise?
faqs.answer: When multi-campus governance, offline-heavy deployments, integration portfolios, or audit-heavy workflows demand priority support and controls.

faqs.question: Can we pilot before expanding?
faqs.answer: Yes—begin with a bounded rollout and expand modules once stakeholders validate workflows.

execution_blocks.title: Align stakeholders
execution_blocks.body: Finance, academics, admissions, and IT review the matrix against policy requirements.

execution_blocks.title: Validate integrations
execution_blocks.body: Enterprise plans coordinate LMS, payments, messaging, and identity expectations early.

execution_blocks.title: Plan rollout waves
execution_blocks.body: Phase portals and offline capture after core records stabilize.
